grid.title: Grid sensor
grid.description: A bidirectional sensor: positive when importing, negative when exporting.

data_description.invert_grid: Required if the sensor reports positive values while exporting.

split.title: Separate sensors
split.description: Both values must always be positive.

data_description.consumption_includes_battery: Required if the consumption sensor already includes battery charging.

battery.title: Home battery
battery.description: Optional. Without a home battery, leave the fields empty and confirm.

data_description.battery_power_entity: A bidirectional sensor: positive when charging, negative when discharging.
data_description.battery_charge_entity: Alternative to the bidirectional sensor: two always-positive sensors.
data_description.battery_mode: Charging power always counts as available. This setting determines whether discharging reduces the surplus.
data_description.battery_min_soc: Below this state of charge, charging takes precedence and no surplus is reported.
data_description.battery_reserve_w: Power always kept for the battery. It counts towards the maximum charge power rather than adding to it.
data_description.battery_max_charge_w: Lets the battery take part in the priority order as a shiftable load, and at the same time caps how much surplus it receives in total. Higher-priority loads are served first and stay on; at its rank the battery sets aside up to this power, less any reserve already configured; only the remainder is available to lower-priority loads. 0 disables participation.

error.battery_entity_required: Maximum charge power only takes effect with a battery reading. Without a charge, discharge or state-of-charge sensor there is no way to tell whether the battery is charging or full. One of the battery entities in this form is required.
error.soc_entity_required: Minimum state of charge only takes effect with a state-of-charge sensor. Without one the limit has no effect.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Manager is already set up.

data_description.smoothing_window: Smooths the surplus and prevents changing cloud cover from causing frequent switching. 0 disables smoothing.
data_description.settle_time: For this long after a switching action the same load is left alone; meanwhile the automation deducts the switched power itself. The value should be at least as large as the delay of the power sensor, which can be several minutes with sluggish smart plugs.

data_description.power_entity: Current power draw. Without it the rated power is used.
data_description.min_power: Switching on starts at this surplus. Without a value the rated power applies.
data_description.max_power: Fallback for the demand while no switch-on threshold is set. It does not cap the device during operation.
data_description.hysteresis: Dead band against oscillation around zero.
data_description.turn_on_delay: The surplus must be sufficient for this long without interruption before switching on. Bridges short drops in production.
data_description.turn_off_delay: The deficit must persist for this long before switching off. Bridges brief drops.
data_description.min_runtime: The device stays on at least this long after being switched on.
data_description.min_off_time: The device stays off at least this long after switching off. Protects compressors from restarting too early.

error.switch_in_use: This device is already switched by another load. Two entries for the same device cause the automation to plan it twice. The entity ID need not match the display name; please verify.

options.split: Separate sensors for production and consumption

force_on.name: Force on
force_on.description: Switches a load on regardless of the surplus and keeps it running for the given duration. Also works with the main switch off, as this is an operation rather than an automation decision.

device_id.name: Load
device_id.description: The load's device. An entity of the same device is also accepted.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: For this long the automation will not switch the device off again.

clear_force.name: End forced run
clear_force.description: Ends a running forced run early. Nothing is switched off; from this point the surplus decides again.

device_id.name: Load
device_id.description: The load's device. An entity of the same device is also accepted.

pause.name: Pause automation
pause.description: Stops the automation. Without a duration it stays disabled until resumed manually.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: The automation resumes automatically after this time. Without a value the pause is indefinite.

not_loaded.message: The Energy Manager integration is not set up.

not_a_consumer.message: {target} is not an Energy Manager load.
